title: Duck Quack
blurb: One assertive quack, and somehow it has never once failed to be funny. The quack is comedy's most efficient animal sound: response, interruption, verdict, occasionally a complete argument, and none of it needs the setup other sounds demand. Play it into any silence and the silence improves measurably. Nobody has satisfactorily explained why this particular noise carries so much comic authority. The myth that a quack does not echo is false, incidentally, though the effect on a group chat remains entirely reliable and needs no further justification.
